ValidationRule.description: VR for: Prevent Unchecking Survey Sent, Prevent Updates After Interaction Ended
ValidationRule.errorConditionFormula:
AND ( $Setup.Salesforce_Library_Settings__c.Disable_VRs__c = false, RecordType.DeveloperName = "Message", AND ( ISCHANGED(Send_Survey__c), ISPICKVAL(Status__c, "Ended") )
)
ValidationRule.errorMessage: Send Survey field cannot be updated after the interaction has ended
